full_judgment: 2. The plaintiff respondents filed Title Suit No.88 of 1993 in the 4th Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka for partition. They filed an application for amendment of the plaint which was allowed by the trial Court by order No. 144 dated 5-7-93. By the said amendment the plaintiffs prayed for a new relief in the plaint to the effect that they be allowed a decree to purchase the share of defendant, No 8, Sharif Abdul Mannan and consequential relief be passed in pursuance thereof. The Rule issued in the petitioner's civil revision case was discharged.
